page: Amazon Web Services c8ib.48xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. It features an Intel x86_64 processor delivering dedicated vCPU allocation across 96 physical cores and 192 virtual CPUs, operating at a base clock speed of 3.9 GHz.

The instance is provisioned with 384.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 compute-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include bundled local instance storage, requiring workloads to interface exclusively with remote network storage volumes. In addition, hardware accelerators are absent, with a GPU count of zero.

Networking capabilities are characterized by a 200 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, accommodating large data transfers between distributed nodes. The resource profile emphasizes raw CPU thread density and network throughput while trading off local disk caching. This architecture fits compute-bound execution, including distributed high-performance computing, large-scale batch processing, compilation tasks, and high-throughput network serving.
